Package io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator

Class EMFFeatureMapSetter

java.lang.Object
io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator.EMFConfigurableFeatureSetter<org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EAttribute,org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EReference,org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject>
io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator.EMFInstanceCreatorFeatureSetter<org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EAttribute>
io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator.EMFFeatureMapSetter
public class EMFFeatureMapSetter extends EMFInstanceCreatorFeatureSetter<org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EAttribute>
Responsible for populating EMF feature maps. Feature maps allow heterogeneous collections where different types can be mixed. This class creates entries in the feature map for each group member defined via ExtendedMetaData.

      protected void setMultiFeature(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject owner, org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EAttribute featureMapAttribute)
